description: `council --yes` (cli.py's cmd_council / council.py convene) seats two distinct vendors, splits a pane per seat, and appends one ordinary `event=dispatch` routing-log line per councillor with `role=council` (accounts.Selection.log_line — there is no `event=council` line). Scout gap #1. Each `task=` is Python `dispatch.task_id_for` `{date}-council-{seat}-{digest}`: after `normalize._ID_RE` that shape is a bare `<ID>` followed by a tab; the pre-parity Rust `{date}-council-{digest}-{seat}` would leave `-<short>` after the placeholder. This is a live pane/agent lifecycle (pane split, agent start/rename, prompt, wait), so it is seeded against the stateful `fake-herdr` binary via `herdr_seed` rather than `fake_herdr.py`'s ordered transcript player (same convention as scratch-close-drives-a-live-pane). `MV_FAKE_HERDR_CALLS` records every Herdr argv, including the two `pane split` calls. fake-herdr's brief.md-in-prompt shortcut writes each seat's `result.md`/`status` so the council is quorate. Only --impl rust supports `herdr_seed`.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.claude-personal]
kind = "claude"
short = "cp"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{DIR:claude-home}}"
pool = "claude:personal"
command = "claude-personal"

[accounts.codex-work]
kind = "codex"
short = "cw"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "chatgpt:work"

[roles.council]
write_scope = "none"

[roles.council.models]
claude = "opus"
codex = "gpt-x"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
council = ["claude-personal", "codex-work"]
